structuredContent.description: Standalone small MAGE FIREBALL projectile sprite for a top-down dark fantasy pixel-art game. Horizontal flight to the RIGHT. One round compact amber-orange head centered at pixel (78,64), diameter about 26 pixels. A SHORT three-tongue copper-orange tail extends LEFT, total visible width about 62 pixels, height about 30 pixels, plenty of transparent margin. Warm copper #955636, burnt orange #dc8648, amber #fba35e, narrow ivory #ffdb9b core. Large clean pixel clusters, simple restrained silhouette, 2 or 3 shading levels, subtle dark selective outline. Small ordinary mage spell, not an ultimate. Camera fixed; exactly one projectile. No explosion, smoke cloud, long streamer, neon halo, bloom, random spark confetti, ornate details, background scene, floor, character, text or sprite sheet. Match the supplied hero's pixel-art rendering quality, not its colours.
